note: proofctl domain policy for RH Obstruction Theory. Unlike the AASVS sibling (which gates a single RH-implying certificate via CORE-0..5), this domain gates PER-THEOREM evidence: each theorems/<id> must pass the program §14 acceptance tests, and its status is BLOCKED if any analytic dependency is missing or a premise is used above its inspected evidence level (CLAIM_LEDGER two-axis). Status is derived by proofctl; producer PASS flags are ignored.
forbidden_runtimes_note: A theorem may STUDY zeros/RH-equivalences as its object (e.g. the CCM convergence conjecture); the ban is on using a zero table / fitted ordinate / RH-equivalent positivity as an established PREMISE inside a proof step. discovery/ may use them; theorems/*/checker may not.
required_claims_note: No global required claims: the deliverable is a portfolio, not one certificate. Each theorems/<id> registers its own contract under domain/contracts/ and is judged independently.

acceptance_tests.note: Program §14. A contract asserting is_barrier_claim=true MUST carry a passing result for every formal test below; computational tests apply when a witness is present.
formal: class:        membership in the method/candidate class is mathematically checkable
non_vacuity:  at least one serious published construction lies in the class
target:       the two adversarial objects genuinely differ on the target predicate
observation:  equality of observations is exact, not numerical coincidence
invariant:    the obstruction survives all equivalences allowed by the class
no_rh:        neither RH nor a known RH-equivalent is among the hypotheses
escape:       at least one explicit route outside the class is identified
scope:        the conclusion names the ambient class and the resource bound
computational: exact rational or interval replay where applicable
independent reconstruction from raw prime-power / moment data
adversarial mutation of every witness field

evidence_gate.note: Gate A (program §6.A). A dependency may back a proof step only if its CLAIM_LEDGER mathematical axis is INDEPENDENTLY-CHECKED or REFEREED. Anything at PROOF-DRAFT/CONJECTURE, or any item with usable_as_premise:false, must appear instead as an explicit assumption in statement.md, or the theorem status is BLOCKED.

non_barrier_labels.note: CLAUDE.md hard boundary + program §3.3. A contract MUST set is_barrier_claim=false if the result is any of these; it may still be published as the stated kind.

module_import_policy.note: Per-theorem non-anticipation barrier: a construction/adversary module must not import the target-predicate or comparison module of the same theorem. Concrete module names are declared in each theorem's contract.
